jobs.title: Graduate Planner
jobs.description:
Right across infrastructure, there’s a requirement to not only maintain, but also renew and reimagine. Whatever stage you’re at in your career, with us you’ll have an opportunity to grow and develop. Delivering essential infrastructure services for life, while being safety first, and client and customer centric in a friendly, fun and respectful environment where you are encouraged to thrive.


**Where will you be working?**



At **M Group Energy,** we’re enabling the energy essential to support our lives.


We provide an end\-to\-end service, delivering solutions in electricity transmission, distribution, renewable energy, EV, metering and home decarbonisation.



We have an exciting opportunity for a **Graduate Planner** to join our **UK Power Networks Team.** We design, build and commission substations at voltages up to and including 400kV. Our teams construct and maintain transmission lines and substations, ensuring the efficient and reliable delivery of electricity.


**As a Graduate Planner, you’ll get the opportunity to:**


As a Graduate Planner you will be part of our planning department who are responsible for producing robust and detailed programmes for all works associated with the design, procurement, and construction phases of the projects. Also, a key part of the role will be liaising with the Project/Construction Manager and Site Engineers to ensure that the programme keeps up\-to\-date with any changes.


**M Group’s Graduate Programme**



A structured development programme designed to help graduate and degree apprentices to build the skills, experience and confidence needed to become one of M Group's future leaders. Throughout your journey, you'll broaden your knowledge, develop your professional capabilities and benefit from a supportive network that empowers you to achieve your full potential.



As an M Group Graduate or Degree Apprentice, you can look forward to:


* **Tailored development opportunities** including face\-to\-face development events, virtual workshops and team\-building experiences. These opportunities are designed to strengthen your leadership, communication and collaboration skills while helping you build connections across the business.
* **A structured learning journey** covering a range of topics including leadership, communication, commercial awareness, sustainability, project management and AI, helping you develop the skills needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving industry.
* **Networking opportunities** with graduates, degree apprentices, business leaders and colleagues from across M Group, enabling you to build meaningful relationships and expand your professional network.
* **Professional development support**, with access to guidance, resources and support to help you work towards relevant professional qualifications and achieve your long\-term career ambitions.
* **A strong support network** from our Early Careers Team, business leaders and peers across the organisation, providing encouragement, insight and practical support throughout your development journey.


At M Group, we're committed to helping you grow and succeed, providing the experiences, connections and opportunities you need to thrive in your career and make a lasting impact.


**We’d love to hear from you if you have:**


* **A degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Mathematics (or are due to graduate this year)**
* Great communication skills and a willingness to learn
* A collaborative approach and a drive to make a difference
* A full EU/UK driving licence and willingness to travel to project sites


**What’s in it for you?**



We offer a range of benefits designed to support your life in and out of work, including:


* Matched or contributory pension scheme
* Online GP service, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
* Employee assistance programme
* My Rewards portal, access to 1000’s of retail discounts
* Life assurance
* Cycle to work, salary finance and give as you earn schemes
* Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
* Reward and recognition scheme


**About us**



We want to be an employer of choice and a great place to work, attracting diverse and talented people, who join us and make a difference. We’re one of the **Top 100 UK companies actively supporting and recruiting army veterans**. Our **ENABLE inclusion networks** bring together people who have a shared passion, to help create an environment where everyone belongs.



Our values help to shape our culture and how we work with one another. We recruit with these values in mind, to ensure your aspirations and ways of working align with ours:


* **We’re responsible** and go further for our people, clients, communities and the planet
* **We’re open** and seek new and better ways of exceeding expectations
* **We’re together** and as one team; the whole is greater than the sum of the parts
* **We’re ambitious** and embrace opportunity, to lead essential infrastructure services for life


Whether you’re a trainee, apprentice or graduate, or progressing through your career, our people benefit from industry recognised programmes, training and development.



It’s an exceptional time to be a part of **M Group**.


**Please note:** Occasionally, job adverts might be closed before the stated closing date. Do apply as soon as possible to ensure your application is considered.



For certain roles, successful candidates will be subject to 3rd party background checks as part of the hiring process. Some roles require drug and alcohol testing as part of induction and onboarding.

jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 28899
Category: Engineering \- Planning / Environmental
Job Type: Full\-time  

ESB Engineering \& Major Projects is seeking a Senior Spatial Planner to join us on our journey to a Brighter Future as ESB delivers on its Net Zero 2040 strategy, with the key objective of delivering resilient infrastructure.



Join our Planning and Consenting Team, who specialise in:



* Planning Applications (including SID \& Offshore)
* Consent Applications (including MAC \& EPA Licences)
* Planning Compliance Discharge
* Strategic Planning \& Project Planning Advice
* Stakeholder Engagement with Key Entities in the Planning Process
This position is based in the multi\-disciplinary Planning and Environment Group within the Generation Engineering Department. The Gen Eng P\&E Group specialises in supporting ESB Generation \& Trading as it delivers on its Net Zero 2040 strategy via the development of new generation assets in Ireland and UK, both onshore and offshore and with the operational activities of existing generation assets.

  




**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead multidisciplinary teams and take responsibility for the preparation of applications for planning permission, strategic infrastructure and marine area developments to the appropriate statutory authorities for projects in Ireland and UK, in compliance with legislative requirements.
* Provide expert planning advice to project teams across Generation Engineering and Generation Projects to successfully scope and deliver projects in a timely manner by contributing to feasibility, screening and other studies for sites as required by ESB.
* Demonstrate and apply a detailed understanding of existing and emerging planning legislation, including marine planning legislation, and have an ability to brief colleagues and project teams in relation to project consenting.
* Lead interactions and consultations with external stakeholders and statutory authorities such as local authorities, An Coimisiún Pleanála (ACP) and Marine Area Regulatory Authority (MARA).
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of relevant environmental regulatory requirements for ESB development projects.

  


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**



**Essential**



* Level 8 Town/Spatial Planning Degree or equivalent.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant planning experience.
* In\-depth knowledge and experience of planning legislation (existing and emerging) and consenting for major infrastructure developments in Ireland and ability to translate new and changing regulatory requirements into workable directions for project teams.
* High level of specialist expertise and strong technical capability and proven ability to manage significant projects or key aspects of projects and deliver high performance results.
* Strong safety awareness and communication skills.
* Valid driver's license for ROI, access to a car, and flexibility to travel nationwide
* Strong stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills and proven track record of managing internal and external stakeholders.
**Desirable**



* Chartered status or working towards it in a recognised professional institution.

* Other related qualifications including project management

This position will be based in ESB E\&MP’s Offices in The Siding's Dublin or Eastgate Cork.

The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

  




**Reporting To**



Gen Eng P\&E Group \- Planning and Consenting Team Lead.

* Career development through mentoring and training

jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job no:** 541128  

**Work type:** Staff Full\-Time  

**Location:** Main Campus (Gainesville, FL)  

**Categories:** Information Technology  

**Department:**61040000 \- VPBA\-TECHNICAL SERVICES  


**Classification Title:**

GIS Analyst

  

  

**Classification Minimum Requirements:**

A bachelor's degree in an appropriate area of specialization or an equivalent combination of education and experience and three years professional experience. Two years of GIS experience required.

  

  

**Job Description:**

**GIS System Design and Quality Assurance** – Design, develop, and maintain GIS applications, automated workflows, scripts, and data processes that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality of GIS systems. Support integrations between GIS and enterprise systems where applicable. Assist with documentation of integrations and system processes to support continuity and long\-term maintenance. Perform and coordinate QA/QC processes to identify discrepancies and reconcile information across multiple data sources and systems. Develop, document, and maintain data standards, workflows, and procedures to support consistent data management and long\-term usability. Assist with the review of facility drawings, spatial datasets, and documentation for completeness, consistency, and accuracy. Coordinate GIS\-related tasks and workflows across departments and translate operational needs into technical GIS requirements.

  

**GIS Support**– Maintain and oversee GIS datasets related to campus infrastructure, utilities, facilities, buildings, and property assets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across systems. Perform spatial data editing, maintenance, reconciliation, and updates using GIS, CAD, BIM, and related technologies. Support integration between GIS, Autodesk products, document management systems, and other facility\-related platforms. Compile, organize, and maintain spatial and tabular datasets from surveys, as\-builts, construction documents, field observations, and institutional records.  

  

**GIS Reporting and Analysis** – Create maps, dashboards, reports, visualizations, and spatial analyses to support operational needs, planning efforts, facilities management, utilities, and university decision\-making. Support the configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement of GIS web applications, mobile tools, and data services. Assist with identifying opportunities to improve accessibility and usability of spatial data resources for campus stakeholders.  

  

**Strategic and Departmental Support** –Support strategic initiatives involving campus space, infrastructure, and facilities data. Assist in maintaining documentation related to GIS systems, datasets, and operational procedures. Participate in special projects. Collaborate across functional areas, including facilities, utilities, planning, construction, and operations, to ensure GIS data and workflows align with business and operational requirements. Provide technical support, guidance, and training to internal users related to GIS resources, applications, and workflows. Respond to stakeholder requests for maps, data, and spatial analysis support.


**Other Duties as Assigned** – Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor to support department and university operational needs.
  

  

NOTE: Management retains the right to modify or add duties at any time.



Criminal Background Check Required.


**NORMAL WORK SCHEDULE:**



* Normal work schedule: Monday through Friday, 08:00 am to 05:00 pm
* Flexibility to adjust work schedule is required to meet department demand of occasional evening or weekend work (including emergency situations) to ensure business operations are functioning optimally during extended hours. Emergency situations may include computer or server failures, application issues, or other IT\-related problems. This position may be an after\-hours on\-call position.
  


  

**Expected Salary:**

$70,000\.00 to $85,000\.00 Annually

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

A bachelor's degree in an appropriate area of specialization or an equivalent combination of education and experience and three years professional experience. Two years of GIS experience required.

  

  

**Preferred:**
* Bachelor's degree in geography, computer science, engineering, or related fields.
* Familiarity or experience with AutoCAD and/or BIM.
* Familiarity with utilities and IT infrastructure, networks, and drone mapping is helpful but not required.
* Working knowledge of GIS devices and imagery preferred.
* The ability to read plats/legal descriptions is appropriate but not mandatory.

jobs.title: ASSISTANT PLANNER
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  


City of Allentown  

Position Description  

  

Grade Number: 6N  

Department: Community and Economic Development/Planning and Zoning  

  

GENERAL PURPOSE  

Performs a variety of administrative, technical and entry level planning functions. Works closely to assist Planning and Zoning staff and the public on planning and zoning matters. Works closely with the Planning Commission, other departments, and the public to collect and distribute Land Development and Subdivision Applications. Works closely with Planning staff to assist with state and federal grant reporting.  

  

SUPERVISION RECEIVED
  

Work is subject to technical review through the evaluation of reports and general support. General oversight is usually received from the Planning Director and/or Chief Planner. The position reports to the Chief Planner.  

  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

" Provides technical and administrative support to the Planning Bureau staff and Planning Commission. Prepares all agendas, back\-up materials, comment letters, and minutes for the Planning Commission. Other related responsibilities include assembling all meeting materials and completing resident notification. Task can include serving as the backup for accepting and processing all Major and Minor Land Development Applications, Subdivision Applications, and other related applications.  

" Provides technical and administrative support to the Planning Bureau and other departments that implement U.S. EDA Recompete Grant funds. Tasks primarily include contract entry, expense tracking, and other administrative tasks related to grant reporting. \= Assembles and generates materials to support staff, satisfying grant reporting requirements.  

" Attends public meetings, assisting other planning staff as appropriate.  

" Assists with the preparation of staff reports including data collection, research and relevant property history, including the preparation of written summaries and updates of Vision2030 and other existing plans and grants.  

" Coordinates with applicants, staff, and other departments on all Planning Commission and Land Development required follow\-up (i.e. Land Development Agreements).  

" Assists in file management, ensuring efficient storage and retrieval of necessary documents. These include, but are not limited to, files on land development, state and federal grants.  

" Prepare minutes of meetings of committees served by the Planning Bureau.  

" Acts as liaison between community groups, government agencies, developers and elected officials in developing neighborhood plans.  

" Provides quality and effective customer service with courtesy and understanding to City customers, citizens and internal departments.  

  

NECESSARY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:  

" Knowledge of the principles and practices of city planning and community development.  

" Knowledge of grants administration and accounting, including budgeting, financial reporting, compliance with funding guidelines, and oversight of grant expenditures.  

" Knowledge of principles and practices of research and data collection.  

" Knowledge of effective writing techniques.  

" Statistical, algebraic, or geometric knowledge and ability to apply such knowledge in practical situations.  

" Knowledge or ability to learn EnerGov.  

" Knowledge/familiarity with GIS preferred.  

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS  

Associate's Degree in Public Administration, Business Administration or Management, Urban Planning, Construction Management, Social Sciences or related field and one (1\) year experience in planning, public policy, grant administration and/or accounting; or a Bachelor's Degree with 0\-1 year experience; or any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.  

  

TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT USED  

Requires intensive daily use of personal computer. Occasional use of digital camera, scanner, and plotter.  

  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

  

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit and talk or listen. The employee is required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, computer, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. Frequent walking is required.  

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.  

  

WORK ENVIRONMENT  

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Employees are required to drive and occasionally visit project /construction sites, and/or conduct neighborhood visual surveys.  

Attendance at various evening meetings in and out of City Hall is required.  

  

SELECTION GUIDELINES  

Formal application, rating of education and experience; oral interview and reference check; job related tests may be required.  

The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.  

The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**


The Hudson Valley and Connecticut planning and land development practice is seeking a planner to support our growing base of public, private, institutional, and nonprofit clients throughout the region. We are a multidisciplinary team fully\-versed in local, state, and federal permitting and regulatory requirements with particular expertise in land use, zoning, environmental planning, and economic development. Members of our team have held leadership positions with the Urban Land Institute, American Planning Association, Westchester Municipal Planning Federation, and other organizations — bringing familiarity with the latest market trends and professional best practices to our work. The candidate would be based in our White Plains or Stamford, CT office.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Manage, prepare, and review planning analyses, technical reports, and environmental review documents in accordance with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), New York State Environmental Quality Review Act (SEQRA), and New York City Environmental Quality Review (CEQR).
* Conduct site plan reviews, zoning compliance analyses, and comparative studies of land use, demographic conditions, municipal fiscal impacts, and economic activity.
* Manage multidisciplinary internal teams and outside consultants in the preparation of environmental review and planning documents.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, and regulatory agencies throughout the planning and environmental review process.
* Manage project scopes, budgets, schedules, and deliverables.
* Lead community outreach and public engagement activities.
* Attend evening municipal board meetings.
**Essential Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in urban planning or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of professional municipal, land development, or consulting firm experience.
* American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) preferred.
* Solution\-focused and thrives working on multiple projects.
* Enjoys working in a collaborative atmosphere.
* Excellent research, quantitative, written, interpersonal, and oral communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and deadline driven.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and working knowledge of GIS.
* Valid driver’s license.
* Ability to travel throughout New York State and Connecticut.
**Compensation**


Compensation will range from $80k to $95k, and commensurate with experience.

**Why Work at AKRF**


Founded in 1981, AKRF is an award\-winning consulting firm with 400 planners, engineers, designers, economists, ecologists, geologists, historians, archaeologists, acousticians, and many other types of professionals guided by the belief that to be original is to be transformative.


Professionals join and remain at AKRF for our corporate\-casual environment that values flexible work schedules and locations, and balances award\-winning projects with social impact initiatives, charitable giving, and plenty of fun and games. We foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where employees are respected and valued in honor of their identities; we strive to deliver on this promise every day. Our cookie exchanges and ice cream socials are quite the treat.

**What We Offer**


We provide employees with a benefit package that reflects our respect for your workplace contributions, professional goals, and personal priorities. The benefits program at AKRF includes:

* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance
* Vacation and Sick time
* Flexible work schedules and locations
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
* Additional Voluntary Life Insurance
* Short\- and Long\-Term Disability
* Stock Ownership
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Training and professional development courses
* Opportunities for community outreach through internal networks
* Charitable donation match
* Transit/parking program

**Work Authorization Disclaimer**


Applicants should be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time they apply. Please note that AKRF is not able to sponsor employment visas for this position, now or in the future.


Any offer of employment will be contingent upon verification of authorization to work in the United States, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

**Equal Opportunity Company**


AKRF enforces a policy of equal employment opportunity in our daily operations. The firm has a demonstrated history of hiring, training, developing, promoting and retaining minority group members and women. All employment\-related decisions are based solely on relevant criteria and without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, sexual identity, caregiver status, military/veteran status or citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Job Description
  
  

Strategic ACI is looking for a Geospatial Analyst to be a member of our team in support of Army TENCAP.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Supports geospatial system integration and testing exercises and events.
  
Evaluate 2D and 3D geospatial data formats and standards for incorporation into the Army Geospatial Enterprise (AGE) and future Army systems.

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
At The IRONMAN Group, our purpose is clear: to inspire people to unlock their greatest potential through sport, pushing beyond limits to become the fullest expression of human achievement. Through our BE ICONIC vision, we are building the most loved brands, producing the world’s most inspiring events, and fostering deeply engaged communities that change lives. We aim to empower over a million athletes to cross a finish line each year and inspire a billion people worldwide through the power of the human spirit.

  




As part of our team, you’ll join a high\-performance, caring culture where innovation thrives, communities are uplifted, and every achievement, big or small, is celebrated. You’ll help shape experiences that fill hearts, consume minds, and enrich souls. This is more than a job. It’s a chance to be part of a global movement, to lead from the front, and to leave a legacy. Together, we create moments that last a lifetime. The IRONMAN Group is the world's largest operator of mass participation sports, delivering over 200\+ events a year across 55\+ countries thanks to a passionate global team. For more information, visit www.ironman.com/about\-ironman\-group.

  



We are seeking a highly motivated individual for the position of **Assistant Planner** reporting to **Sr Director, Planning** based in our **Tampa, Florida** office.

  

**The Opportunity:**

  




The Assistant Planner supports the planning and inventory management function by maintaining inventory reporting, executing inventory transactions, monitoring inventory performance, and assisting with forecasting and allocation activities. This role plays a critical part in ensuring inventory accuracy and supporting the successful execution of merchandise sales across IRONMAN events and eCommerce channels.

  



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, detail\-oriented, and eager to develop a career in merchandise planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations. They thrive working with data, have strong Excel skills, and enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams to solve problems and drive operational execution.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**

  


**Inventory Management \& Reporting**


* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
* Monitor inventory levels across warehouses, trailers, and event inventory locations.
* Track inventory receipts, transfers, adjustments, and replenishment activities.
* Research and resolve inventory discrepancies.
* Support inventory reconciliation and cycle count processes.


**Planning Support**


* Assist planners with forecasting, inventory analysis, and assortment planning.
* Prepare sales, inventory, and performance reports for weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Analyze historical sales and inventory trends to support future planning decisions.
* Maintain planning tools, trackers, and reporting dashboards.
* Support inventory allocation and deployment plans for events and eCommerce.


**Event Inventory Execution**


* Assist in preparing inventory plans for races and events.
* Support inventory transfers to and from race locations.
* Monitor inventory availability leading up to events.
* Assist with post\-event inventory reporting and analysis.
* Partner with Event Operations and Merchandise teams to ensure accurate inventory movement.


**Data Management \& Systems**


* Maintain accurate product, inventory, and planning data within company systems.
* Ensure inventory transactions are completed accurately and timely.
* Support the integrity of planning, inventory, and reporting systems.
* Assist with system testing, process improvements, and implementation of projects.
* Create and update standard operating procedures as needed.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with Merchandising, Product Development, Event Operations, Logistics, and Warehouse teams.
* Respond to inventory and reporting requests from business partners.
* Support initiatives to improve inventory visibility and operational efficiency.
* Assist with special projects and seasonal business initiatives.


**Culture**


* Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and respectful team environment by demonstrating professionalism, accountability, and collaboration in all interactions.
* Embrace IRONMAN’s BE ICONIC mindset by bringing an athlete\-first perspective, taking ownership of work, and showing pride in delivering exceptional experiences.
* Communicate openly and constructively with teammates and cross\-functional partners to support efficient execution and problem solving.
* Demonstrate adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, learning from each event and contributing ideas to improve processes and experiences.
* Act as a culture carrier onsite and offsite, recognizing that individual behaviors directly shape the athlete, volunteer, and team experience.

  


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 1\-3 years of experience in planning, allocation, inventory management, supply chain, merchandising, or analytical roles.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.
* Experience working with ERP, inventory, or planning systems preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  


*We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law. We also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment in accordance with applicable law.*
